questionText:

options.text: Both (A) and (R) are true and (R) is the correct explanation of (A)

detailedSolution:
Detailed Solution:
Both (A) and (R) are true, and (R) is the correct explanation of (A). Hence Option C is correct.
Hence, option (A) is the correct choice.

(I) Reciprocal inhibition and counter-conditioning of phobias
